svg.title: How call-agy Works — Plain-Language Flow
svg.desc: An ELI5 explanation of call-agy: one natural language prompt from the host agent forwards directly to official headless agy CLI, executes securely inside the official sandbox, and returns a structured handoff.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

g.text: HOW IT WORKS · ONE PROMPT IS ALL IT TAKES
100% OFFICIAL AGY CLI · ZERO CREDENTIAL LEAKS · NO PROXY
